verified_behavior: The current filter scope, selectable count, paper count and readable bank version are visible before drawing.
Random selection is performed from the server-computed ready and readable pool; the client cannot supply candidate ids.
An empty scope returns no selection and does not broaden or reset filters.
The selected question is highlighted but is not started until the student explicitly confirms Select.
needs_review and invalid items remain visible in the repository UI; invalid items cannot enter study.
Question analysis and answer fields are not returned by the random endpoint.
The standalone bank page and chat picker share a question-number navigator for multi-question papers.
Selecting a question number scrolls to and focuses the target card, while aria-current=location identifies the active target.
A random result is automatically located and focused without starting the question.
The H5 navigator is sticky and uses 44px touch targets; the PC navigator remains compact.
The standalone bank stores a random target and its non-empty filters in the URL, then restores the same random highlight and focus after refresh.
A restored random result remains unconfirmed and keeps the Select action available; it is not mislabeled as an already selected question.
Normal filter changes and confirmed question links also retain the non-empty filter scope in the URL.
limitations: The imported real bank currently contains only ready items, so needs_review and invalid visibility is proven with component/service fixtures rather than real imported records.
The product intentionally draws only from ready, readable items and discloses excluded counts; this does not satisfy the original AT02 wording that random candidates include invalid items.
Random selection idempotency is process-local for ten minutes and is not yet durable across a server restart.
The user explicitly rejected hash fields, so no persisted scope hash exists.
